Name: HUD Ballistic Trajectory Overlay DX11 Occlusion
Description: DX11 edition of HUD Ballistic Trajectory Overlay v6 with obstacle occlusion for the local player's guide. Preserves the established thin line, throwable behavior, and long-arc coverage. Uses the original build-validated scene query, with at most 32 additional visibility samples per drawn guide and short-lived reuse when the camera and trajectory stay nearly still. Disable other overlay editions before deploying.

Options.Name: Overlay
Options.Description: Trajectory guides and lifetime markers. HUDBTO.ini is created if missing and read once at mission start.
